verses.text: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up the mountain and sat down. His disciples came over to him.
Then he began teaching them:
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, because Heaven’s Kingdom belongs to them.
“Blessed are those who mourn; they will be comforted.
“Blessed are the gentle; they will inherit the earth.
“Blessed are those hungry and thirsty for righteousness; they will be filled.
“Blessed are the merciful; they will receive mercy.
“Blessed are the pure in heart; they will see God.
“Blessed are the peacemakers; they will be called God’s children.
“Blessed are those persecuted for doing what’s right, because Heaven’s Kingdom belongs to them.
“You’re blessed when people insult you, persecute you, and make up all kinds of evil stories about you because of me.
“Be glad—yes, celebrate! Your reward in heaven is great. They persecuted the prophets before you the same way. 🎉
“You are the earth’s salt. But if salt loses its flavor, how will it get salty again? It’s no good anymore; people throw it out and walk all over it.
“You are the world’s light. A city sitting on a hill can’t be hidden.
“Nobody lights a lamp and hides it under a measuring basket. They put it on a stand, and it lights up everyone in the house.
“In the same way, let your light shine in front of people. They’ll see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
“Don’t think I came to scrap the Law or the Prophets. I didn’t come to scrap them; I came to fulfill them.
“I’m telling you the truth: heaven and earth may pass away, but not even the smallest letter or tiny pen-stroke will disappear from the Law until everything is fulfilled.

“So whoever breaks even one of the least commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in Heaven’s Kingdom. But whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in Heaven’s Kingdom.
“I’m telling you, unless your righteousness goes beyond that of the scribes and Pharisees, you won’t enter Heaven’s Kingdom.
“You heard what was said long ago: ‘Don’t murder.’ Whoever murders will face judgment.
“But I’m telling you: anyone angry with his brother without a cause will face judgment. Whoever says ‘Raca!’ will answer to the council; whoever says ‘You fool!’ faces the fire of Gehenna.
“So if you’re bringing your gift to the altar and remember your brother or sister has something against you,
“leave your gift there in front of the altar. Go make peace with them first, then come back and offer your gift.
“Settle things quickly with your accuser while you’re on the way to court. Otherwise, they may hand you to the judge, the judge to the officer, and you’ll end up in prison.
“I’m telling you the truth: you won’t get out until you’ve paid the last penny.
“You heard it said: ‘Don’t commit adultery.’
“But I’m telling you, whoever keeps looking at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
“If your right eye trips you up, tear it out and throw it away. Better to lose one part of you than have your whole body thrown into Gehenna.
“If your right hand trips you up, cut it off and throw it away. Better to lose one part of you than have your whole body thrown into Gehenna.
“It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
“But I’m telling you: anyone who divorces his wife, except because of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
“Again, you heard what was said long ago: ‘Don’t make false vows; keep the vows you make to the Lord.’
“But I’m telling you, don’t swear at all—not by heaven, because it’s God’s throne;
“not by the earth, because it’s the stool for his feet; not by Jerusalem, because it’s the city of the great King.
“And don’t swear by your own head—you can’t make one hair turn white or black.
“Let your ‘Yes’ mean yes, and your ‘No’ mean no. Anything beyond that comes from the evil one.
“You heard it said: ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
“But I’m telling you, don’t fight back against an evil person. If someone slaps your right cheek, turn the other one too.
“If someone sues you for your coat, let them have your cloak too.
“If someone forces you to go one mile, go two with them.
“Give to the person who asks you, and don’t turn away someone who wants to borrow from you.
“You heard it said: ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
“But I’m telling you: love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to people who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat and persecute you.
“Then you’ll be children of your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on evil people and good people, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
“If you love only people who love you, what reward is that? Even tax collectors do the same.
“If you greet only your friends, what’s special about that? Even tax collectors do the same.
“So be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.”
